Thanks Alex / Marissa — I can take the hands-on session. Proposed agenda for the 90m working session:
- 0–10m: Quick recap of goals / success criteria
- 10–35m: Prompt walkthrough + prompt tuning recommendations (prompt design patterns we’ll try)
- 35–65m: Routing + model variant tests (primary vs fallback; metrics to observe)
- 65–85m: Load smoke test (we’ll run a gradual ramp to the 20 req/s target)
- 85–90m: Next steps / action items

Prep items we need from BrightMode before the working session:
- Representative prompt set (10–20 prompts) + expected outputs or acceptance criteria
- Small dataset (S3 link or CSV) to simulate typical input
- An infra contact who can run a short network test if we need to exercise VPC/private endpoints

Operational notes: we recommend a separate 30-min dry run for the load smoke test on your infra (can be same week) so we don’t impact production systems. Also please let us know whether you prefer API key auth or temporary IAM role for the hands-on test.

Cheers,
